title: `AtlasTexture` in `AnimatedTexture` frames doesn't change
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Windows 10 - v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6] | Compatibility - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 -  AMD Ryzen 5 5600G CPU

### Issue description

When i add an `AtlasTexture` as a frame of an `AnimatedTexture`  code says that frames are changing but visually it remains as one frame.

code: 

```gdscript
extends Node2D

@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	print(sprite.texture.current_frame)

```

### Steps to reproduce

1. create 2d scene
2. add a `Sprite2D` node
3. set `texture` of it to new AnimatedTexture
4. set `frames` to amout of frames your spritesheet has
5. set frame's texture to new AtlasTexture
6. set `atlas` to your spritesheet 
7. click `Edit Region`
8. make a region that suit single frame of your spritesheet
9. repeat for every frame

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp_2025-04-20_06-15-16.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19823377/mrp_2025-04-20_06-15-16.zip)
